title: Very terse summary (11 lines, abbreviations) for a patient who left against medical advice (AMA, pac_* not applicable); no nursing instructions

rationale.final_diagnosis: EDGE (terse): 'Dx: acute alcoholic pancreatitis' states the final diagnosis even without a formal section header.
rationale.hospital_course: EDGE (terse): one abbreviated line lists treatments and that he left AMA on hospital day 3, but gives little on how he responded beyond a lipase trend; incomplete rather than absent.
rationale.discharge_condition: EDGE (terse): 'Condition: stable, A&O x3, ... ambulatory' gives clinical and mental status at discharge.
rationale.disposition: Left against medical advice is a stated disposition.
rationale.followup: 'PCP prn' names no clinician and no timeframe.
rationale.pcp_named: No PCP or follow-up clinician is named.
rationale.discharge_meds: Thiamine and folic acid are listed with dose, route and frequency as the discharge medications.
rationale.info_transmitted: Nothing says the summary was sent anywhere.
rationale.dp_evaluation: No discharge planning evaluation of post-hospital needs is documented; the AMA departure preempted it.
rationale.dp_discussed: Risks of leaving, return precautions and the plan were discussed with the patient, who agreed (written as 'w/ pt').
rationale.goals_of_care: No code status or goals of care are documented; the only expressed preference is that he declined a detox referral, so unclear is also defensible.
rationale.pac_list: EDGE: AMA departure is not a post-acute referral, so the pac rules do not apply.
rationale.pac_choice: EDGE: AMA, not a post-acute referral.
rationale.pac_quality_data: EDGE: AMA, not a post-acute referral.
rationale.meds_consistent: No nursing_instructions document (he left before instructions were given).
